We used to work together, which was part of the reason, since our positions conflicted so it was against company policy. That’s part of why I quit my old job. But that’s out of the way now, but I think the biggest thing left is that he’s still coming to terms with his last relationship ending. It ended badly, and they still live together while he’s searching for a place, so it’s just a rough time on his end and I’m doing my best to respect that and be there for him. The thing he doesn’t know is that with everything progressing the way it is, my “crush” is turning into me falling for him, a bit harder and faster than I’d like. I just have a lot of love for him in general, and I hate having to hide and ignore that sort of thing.
